steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Nucleosynthesis is the process by which stars create heavier elements from lighter ones through nuclear fusion | Key Fact: Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen to helium via the proton-proton chain (lower mass) or CNO cycle (higher mass) | Key Fact: The triple-alpha process fuses three helium nuclei into carbon in red giant cores | Key Fact: Massive stars can fuse elements up to iron (Fe) in successive shell layers — iron is the endpoint as fusion beyond iron absorbs energy

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from stellar evolution &amp; nucleosynthesis, and one past-paper question.
